tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: The susceptibility analysis of S. suis CVCC 3928 against antimicrobial.
footnotes: R, resistant; I, intermediate; S, sensitive.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.caption: Degree of inflammation (score) of tissue sections.
footnotes: Mice were infected intraperitoneally with S. suis CVCC 3928 (7.5 × 108 CFU/ml) and treated with MP1102 (5.0 mg/kg) and ceftriaxone (15.0 mg/kg) at 2 h post infection, respectively. Lungs, livers, and spleens were harvested and detected at 1 d and 7 d after treatment. Inflammatory degrees were evaluated from 3 to 0 grades (3, very serious; 2, serious; 1-2: very slight; 1, minor; 0, no inflammation phenomenon).
